subject.title: chore: add bounded Git and pnpm memory diagnostics

question: Should OpenClaw keep this standalone Docker diagnostic in-tree, or should the incident-specific measurement workflow remain in existing ClawSweeper/remote-proof infrastructure?
rationale: The decision sets the long-term ownership and maintenance boundary for a large operational tool; the PR narrative alone cannot establish that product direction.

options.title: Adopt after owner review
options.body: Keep the diagnostic in-tree after an owner verifies its operational boundary, cleanup behavior, and relationship to existing proof tooling.

options.title: Move to existing infrastructure
options.body: Retain the incident learnings but implement the measurement workflow in the existing ClawSweeper or remote-proof tooling instead of adding a repository script.

recommendation.title: Adopt after owner review
recommendation.body: Keep the diagnostic in-tree after an owner verifies its operational boundary, cleanup behavior, and relationship to existing proof tooling.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the diagnostic and supplied the underlying incident evidence, making them the clearest initial routing point for its intended ownership.
